material.acceptance_criteria: A pick of a hero already held by another seat is refused with an error and the seat keeps its previous hero.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:716-724 pick checks only ROSTER membership (unknown-hero at panels.lua:721) and never calls held(). fill skips held heroes (held at panels.lua:680; definition at 627), so the two lobby paths disagree on whether a hero may be held twice.
material.resolution: Pick of a hero held by another seat is refused; the seat keeps its previous hero (91863062). Two-seat variant not witnessed: isolated pages do not share lobby state.
material.subject: Lobby pick lets two seats hold the same hero
material.witness: Live lobby at https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html (Pages from origin tip 7f68d3bc). One page seated in Team A slot 1, bots in slots 2-10 (antimage held by bot seat 2). Pick antimage: seat 1 stays 'Slot 1: you pick a hero'; status '9/10 ready (refused: another seat already has that hero)'. 1280x720: dispatch 1792894671239-5107-4815a1718b2d8642. 375x667: dispatch 1792894674890-5115-518fdb40eb56ca25. Fix 91863062; tip 7f68d3bc CI green (run 40128978828: workspace tests, static client checks, wire codec round-trip all success). The fix sha's own CI (run 40115478029) is red only on workspace tests, the pre-existing panels_route failure that 41907c14 fixed.
material.witness_plan: Live lobby: two pages pick the same hero; the second pick must be refused and the seat's hero unchanged.

witness_request.note: Code fix published (91863062, pick refuses hero-held). Witness is live (two pages pick one hero; second refused). Left pending for the live lobby witness, as for ILLEGAL-trav-hud-lua-L1-1.
